name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions Nginx as a multi-site web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, security hardening, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl tuning, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis services, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and cleanup of generated configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs prerequisites and deploys the dibanez/fastapi_tutorial Python application with a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
